entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I assist you today?
Hi David... I'm calling because I need to return an item. I just... I feel so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. To start, could you tell me your order number?
Yes, it's VF-886-345. It's for the ProFit Jersey.
Thank you. I have the order right here. Before we go further, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's... I guess it's a preference. I ordered the wrong size. I finally got a chance to try it on for a long ride this past weekend and it's just way too tight. I can barely breathe in it.
I see. So the fit wasn't what you were expecting.

Exactly. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I've never had this problem. I saved up for this jersey, and I really needed that money for other things if it wasn't going to work out. I just feel so let down.

I completely understand your frustration. It's no good having gear you can't use. Let me just check the delivery date here... okay, I see it was delivered 42 days ago. One moment while I review the policy.
Alright, I've confirmed it. Our standard return policy allows for returns up to 90 days from the date of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe. We can absolutely get this sorted for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it.
Not at all. I'm happy to help. Would you prefer to return it for a full refund, or would you like to do an exchange for a larger size?
An exchange would be perfect, actually! I still really want the jersey, I just need the right fit. Thank you so much, David.

You're very welcome. I'm processing that exchange for you right now. I've just sent an email to you with a pre-paid return label for the jersey that was too tight. Just drop that in the mail, and we'll have the correct size shipped out to you immediately. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that's everything. You've really turned my day around. Thank you.
It was my pleasure. We appreciate your business. Have a wonderful day and enjoy the new jersey!
